title: Lookup in a packed row stream
statement: Let each row contain $l$ bit-string fields, and let $N$ be a natural number. For any time $t<N$ and coordinate $i<l$, the field at index $tl+i$ in the packed stream of the first $N$ rows is exactly the $i$th field of row $t$.
hypotheses_covered: row family indexed by natural numbers and coordinates in Fin l
replaced: For every row family with $l$ fields per row, bound $N$, time $t < N$, and coordinate $i$, the header field at index $t \cdot l + i$ of the stream of $N$ rows is exactly the field $i$ of row $t$.
